へぇ〜、ここが<Kohaku>と <Hisui>の故郷かぁ
Entry.EnglishText: So this is Kohaku and Hisui's hometown, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: こんにちは！ オレは <Shing>＝メテオライトって いいます
Entry.EnglishText: Hello! I'm Shing Meteoryte!

Entry.JapaneseText: か、歓迎されるって雰囲気じゃ なさすぎだね……
Entry.EnglishText: Wow, talk about a warm welcome...

Entry.JapaneseText: おがえりぃ、<Kohaku>ぅ〜っ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Kohaku, ya came back!

Entry.JapaneseText: うわっ、なんだコイツ!?
Entry.EnglishText: WHOA?! Who's this squirt?

Entry.JapaneseText: カイアぁ、おらなら こっちだべさぁ
Entry.EnglishText: Oi, down 'ere Kya!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……よがったぁ！ おら <Kohaku>が、いぎなし太く なっちまったかと心配したよぉ
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, there ya are! Boy am I glad to see you, I was scared you'd went 'n turned into a pound of steel!

Entry.JapaneseText: この魅惑のボディーに 抱きついておいて その感想は何事だぁッ!?
Entry.EnglishText: HEY!!! I'll have you know I'm a pound of FEATHERS!

Entry.JapaneseText: いやいやいや、驚くのは そこじゃないでしょっ？
Entry.EnglishText: Um, ignoring how wrong that is, that's not the issue here...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kohaku>って 素だと、あんな喋り方なのか……
Entry.EnglishText: Wow, so Kohaku's home dialect is like this, huh...

Entry.JapaneseText: おおぉ…… 見でみぃ……あんお姿を……
Entry.EnglishText: Crikey, would ya look what the cat dragged in...

Entry.JapaneseText: 言い伝えと同じエメラルドの髪…… 本物のリチア様だっぺよ
Entry.EnglishText: Get a load of that emerald hair... that's Lady Lithia, fair dinkum!

Entry.JapaneseText: 静まりなさい！
Entry.EnglishText: Quiet, all of you!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……シーラ叔母さん…… 帰ってきたぜ
Entry.EnglishText: Auntie Sheila. We're home.

Entry.JapaneseText: 無断で里を出た挙句 結晶騎士を連れて 戻って来るとは……
Entry.EnglishText: First you go and leave the village without permission, and then you come back with a Crystal Knight of all things...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kohaku>、<Hisui> どのような了見か じっくり釈明してもらいますよ
Entry.EnglishText: You two have a LOT of explaining to do.

Entry.JapaneseText: 里長さま、久しぶりに <Kohaku>が帰って来たんだぁ。 怒んねぇでやってけろ……
Entry.EnglishText: C'mon Chief, Kohaku hasn't been home in yonks! Cut her some slack...

Entry.JapaneseText: おめぇは黙っとれ！
Entry.EnglishText: You be quiet!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレたちは教会とは関係ないんだ。 クリードって奴をとめるために この里にある——
Entry.EnglishText: We've got nothing to do with the church. We're here to stop Creed-

Entry.JapaneseText: この数の結晶騎士ならば 里を全滅させるのも たやすいでしょうが……
Entry.EnglishText: This many Crystal Knights could easily annihilate our entire village...

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア様の真の教えを守る我ら。 敵わぬまでも、命を捨てて抗うと 覚悟してもらいましょう
Entry.EnglishText: It is our duty to protect Lady Lithia's teachings. We are ready to throw ours life away for our cause, even if defeat is inevitable.

Entry.JapaneseText: 人の話を聞かないおばさんだね！ 教会は関係ないんだってば
Entry.EnglishText: And your some old hag you doesn't listen! The church has NOTHING to do with us!

Entry.JapaneseText: 勝手に侵入した挙句 武器をつきつけて 信じろとわめく……
Entry.EnglishText: You intrude on our land and dare to point your weapons at us?! Unbelieveable...

Entry.JapaneseText: いかにも教会—— いえ、外界の者らしい 厚顔無恥ぶりですね
Entry.EnglishText: Precisely like the church, or perhaps mere brazen outsiders intruding.

Entry.JapaneseText: …………わかった。 信じてもらいたいのは我々だ。 そちらの命に従おう
Entry.EnglishText: ...I understand. If it is to earn your trust, I will obey your every order.

Entry.JapaneseText: クリードの演説は、この里にも 届きました。御身のご無事を お喜び申しあげます
Entry.EnglishText: Creed's speech reached our village as well. I pray for your safety.

Entry.JapaneseText: 真バレイア教の象徴にして この里の創造主——我らが 女神リチア＝スポデューン様
Entry.EnglishText: The symbol of true Velleian faith, is our godess and founder of our village, Lady Lithia Spodune.

Entry.JapaneseText: シーラ…… どうか、わたくしの話を 聞いてください
Entry.EnglishText: Sheila... I beg of you, please hear us out.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……リチア様と<Kohaku> <Hisui>は私の家へ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Lady Lithia, Kohaku and Hisui are going to discuss things at home.

Entry.JapaneseText: 他の者は、<Kohaku>たちの 尋問が済むまで 洞窟の集会所に監禁します
Entry.EnglishText: The others are to be confined to the cave until I've heard the full.

Entry.JapaneseText: 釈明とか尋問とか変だよ！ シーラさんは、<Hisui>と <Kohaku>の家族なんだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: What's all this confinement and interrogation stuff?! Aren't you all family?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Shing>……叔母さんは わたしたちが説得するから 集会所で待ってて
Entry.EnglishText: Shing... we'll get through to our auntie, so please just wait for us he at the assembly hall.

Entry.JapaneseText: わかった……
Entry.EnglishText: Alright...

Entry.JapaneseText: めずらしいじゃねぇか。 ひとりで輪の外にいるなんて？
Entry.EnglishText: Rare for you to not be hanging with the crowd, eh?

Entry.JapaneseText: うん……<Hisui>たちには たくさんの家族がいるんだね
Entry.EnglishText: I was just thinking about how you have such a big family, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: そう思ったら、ちょっとだけ さみしくて、ちょっとだけ うらやましくて……さ
Entry.EnglishText: It just made me feel a little lonely... a little jealous, even...

Entry.JapaneseText: バカ野郎、てめぇなんか もう家族も同然だろーが
Entry.EnglishText: Dumbass! You're part of the family too!

Entry.JapaneseText: え……!? それってオレと <Kohaku>が……
Entry.EnglishText: Huh?! Does that mean you accept me and Kohaku?!

Entry.JapaneseText: ちげ〜〜〜よッ！ 告白もできねぇくせに ずうずうしい妄想すんな!!
Entry.EnglishText: No way in HELL am I accepting a guy who daydreams without even confessing to the girl he likes!

Entry.JapaneseText: ちぇ〜、なんだよ。 自分が、ちょっとかっこよく リチアに伝えられたからって……
Entry.EnglishText: Gee! Look at you, being the relationship police after telling Lithia how you feel.

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんだ、この野郎！ まるで俺があいつに アレみてぇじゃねぇかぁ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Sh-shut the hell up! You make it sound like I've got a thing for her or something!?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ったく、こんな形のねぇもの どう伝えりゃいいんだか……
Entry.EnglishText: ...But man. How's a guy even supposed to get across something as vague as feelings...

Entry.JapaneseText: 人間のスピリアって すごく厄介だよね。みんな それぞれの想いがあって……
Entry.EnglishText: People's Spirias are fickle things. Everyone has their own feelings...

Entry.JapaneseText: なかなかわかりあえなくて ……不安で……傷ついたり 憎みあったりもしちゃうんだ
Entry.EnglishText: There's times where we can't get along, or we stress out, or even come to hate one another...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ……それでも 『わかりあいたい』って 想いが、とめられねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah... But even then, you can't help wanting to be on the same page as them...

Entry.JapaneseText: こんな面倒なスピリアに あふれた世界だからこそ——
Entry.EnglishText: This world is full of annoying Spirias, but hey.

Entry.JapaneseText: オレたちは守りたいんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: All the more reason for us to protect it!

Entry.JapaneseText: どこに出ますか？
Entry.EnglishText: Where are you going?

Entry.JapaneseText: フィールドに出る 街道に出る
Entry.EnglishText: To Field. To pathways.
